description: From now on the machine refuses inbound traffic no rule of its firewalls opens; enforced within about ten seconds of the call. Up to 5 firewalls per machine, rules add up. Refused for a machine with no public address. Attaching again is harmless. Scope: network.write.

firewall.description: Firewall id, as returned by list_firewalls or create_firewall.

vm.description: Machine id, as returned by list_vms or create_vm.

name: attach_firewall
title: Attach a firewall to a machine
